DOP: pasāsati ( and pasāseti ?), pr. 3 sg. [ S. praśāsti], 1. teaches, instructs; S I 38, 16* (saddhā dutiyā purisassa hoti paññā c’ enaṃ ~ati; Spk I 94, 18 foll.: paññā etaṃ purisaṃ idaṃ karohi idaṃ mā karī ti anusāsati); Ja III 367, 13* (pasāsanato nikkhanto idha dāni ~asi); — 2. rules, governs; D II 257, 7* (purimaṃ ca disaṃ rājā Dhataraṭṭho ~ati; Sv 686, 23 foll.: pācīnadisaṃ anusāsati); III 149, 11* (paṭhaviṃ ~ati); Ja IV 274, 14* (rajjaṃ imaṃ dhammaguṇe ~a); V 350, 17* (sabb’ atth’ issariyaṃ bhavataṃ ~atha yad icchatha); VI 579, 6* (etu Vessantaro rājā Siviraṭṭhe ~atu); Cp 3:14:1 (~āmi mahāmahiṃ); — part.pr. ( a ) pasāsa(t), mfn. , D III 64, 28 (tassa samatena janapadaṃ ~ato na pubbe nāparaṃ janapadā pabbanti); Mhv 63:22; ( b ) pasāsanta, pasāsenta, mfn. , Vv-a 264, 26 (~antā); Th-a III 39, 19 ([mahim] āvasanto ti ~ento, eds so ); Mhv 59:15 (rajjaṃ ~ente); — absol. pasāsiya, Nett 139, 4* (dibbaṃ rajjaṃ ~iya); — pp ( a ) pasattha 2 , mfn. [ cf S. praśiṣṭa], governed; directed; Ja V 492, 4* (dhammena me issariyaṃ pasatthaṃ; 492, 27´ foll.: dasavidhaṃ rājadhammaṃ akopetvā dhammen’ eva mayā rajjaṃ pasāsitaṃ, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee pasaṃsitaṃ); ( b ) pasāsita, mfn. , Ja V 492, 28´ ; Mhv 48:128 (ārocetvā pavattiṃ taṃ tehi sammā pasāsito, Se so; Be pakāsito; Ee pasaṃsito).
